findings.title: Hard budgets and worker cleanup are not independent of blocking monitor work
findings.evidence: GPU query may block15s; os.walk/fsync have no deadline; guard checks only before these operations; successful child exit has no final deadline audit. stop_owned adds up to20s beyond already reached caps. After Popen and before supervise, append_event/SIGTERM exceptions have no unconditional child cleanup and can leave the detached worker running.
findings.minimal_fix: Own each spawned PGID in a try/finally from Popen onward. Use an independent hard deadline controller, reserve termination grace within substep/phase/global/GPU caps, keep resource sampling bounded/off the deadline path, and recheck all elapsed caps after wait before success.

findings.title: Failed or killed phases drop measured peak resource evidence
findings.evidence: supervise keeps peak_rss/gpu_peak/storage in local variables and rethrows without returning them. Outer usage remains{} and records only wall/cpu/completedFalse, so failure cost ledger omits measured RAM/VRAM peaks and storage state; monitor.json may retain only an earlier sample.
findings.minimal_fix: Maintain a shared phase usage record updated at each measurement and finalize it for every exception/kill; preserve reason, measured peaks, last storage and termination overhead in the durable phase/cost receipt.

findings.title: Joint matched-quality speed verdict does not qualify the classical comparator
findings.evidence: quality reads only comparisons[test_hybrid], while speed compares CH to min(CF,CC); classical error metrics can violate every frozen field/history/reaction criterion without blocking supports_neural_online_acceleration.
findings.minimal_fix: Compute and report the same quality contract for test_classical and test_hybrid. Freeze how a failed classical quality check limits the matched-quality joint claim; do not silently discard it or change thresholds after results.

findings.title: Complete planned field/evolution evidence is not produced
findings.evidence: Analysis computes only u/v/d GP RMS, A/r/f and reaction errors. The reviewed design/validation contract additionally requires raw/active, energy/branch, front/morphology, negative-damage/healing and fallback/correction diagnostics plus decision-facing fields. Raw states/work records are saved but the required derived reports/figures and fallback summary are absent.
findings.minimal_fix: Add bounded common posthoc analysis from the exact sealed states, with per-channel field/energy/raw-active and feasibility/retreat/correction/fallback summaries and fixed-rule common-scale decision figures/README. These diagnostics must not rescue or replace frozen primary criteria.
